facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Palmulasaurus quadratus, originally named Palmula quadratus.
facts.quote: P. quadratus Albright et al., 2007 (originally Palmula quadratus) (type)

facts.statement: The genus name Palmula was renamed Palmulasaurus because it was already occupied by a different genus described in 1833.
facts.quote: synonyms: Palmula Albright et al., 2007 (preoccupied by Palmula Lea, 1833)

facts.statement: Palmulasaurus belongs to the family Polycotylidae.
Palmulasaurus is the namesake of the subfamily Palmulasaurinae.
The animal was originally described under the name Palmula before the name had to be changed due to a preoccupation with a foraminifera genus from 1833.
facts.quote: It was originally described as Palmula, but that name was already occupied by a genus of Cretaceous foraminifera first described in 1833.

facts.statement: Palmulasaurus lived during the Turonian stage, between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Turonian (93.9 to 89.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Only one fossil occurrence of Palmulasaurus has been recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
